_meta.methodology: Reviewed only official operator location pages, official help/FAQ pages, and publicly visible operator-owned pricing or booking widgets. No accounts were created and no email address, phone number, password, payment information, or other personal data was entered. monthlyPrice is the lowest clearly published ongoing recurring plan that permits ordinary use of the named location; introductory and limited-time discounts are excluded when a regular rate is displayed. For F45, the official $155 biweekly subscription is normalized to $335.83 per calendar month using 26 charges per year divided by 12, with the original cadence retained in priceNote. Mandatory annual, enrollment, initiation/startup, and processing fees are separate fields and are never rolled into monthlyPrice. Null means the operator did not publicly disclose a safely mappable amount.

feeFieldNotes.annualFee: Mandatory fee charged yearly, when explicitly published for the selected plan.
feeFieldNotes.enrollmentFee: One-time enrollment charge, when explicitly published.
feeFieldNotes.initiationFee: One-time initiation or startup charge, when explicitly published.
feeFieldNotes.processingFee: Separate one-time processing charge, when explicitly published.

limitations: Bay Club San Francisco pricing was not published on the reviewed public SF campus and membership pages; the only visible starting price was explicitly tied to Executive Club North Bay and was not reused.

Rumble's current official location finder did not expose an active San Francisco studio. Its public Training FAQ references Marina but requires an account to book and publishes no numeric price, so no Rumble record was created.
Planet Fitness at 417 Montgomery Street was omitted because the official finder marks it temporarily closed for relocation; the new 141 Kearny Street relocation is included and marked coming soon.
FITNESS SF Polk was omitted because it is scheduled to open in September 2026 and its founding price is not publicly displayed.
Crunch New Montgomery was omitted because its former location URL redirects to the general locator and it is absent from the current public SF trial-location list.
Orangetheory Financial District and Mission Bay legacy URLs redirect to the national homepage; only the currently accessible Pacific Heights studio page was recorded.
Taxes and optional add-ons are excluded. Free trials are not treated as dollar-priced day passes.
